package.name: rov_numpy_nn_slam
package.description: RVNN: MuJoCo 3.12.0 + ROS Noetic underwater ROV assignment. 6-DOF physical simulation, keyboard teleoperation, sonar/DVL/IMU/camera sensors, occupancy-grid SLAM, A* navigation, and pure-NumPy neural networks for perception, planning, control and end-to-end sonar-image driving.
